item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: The 3D toolkit: turn an image into a 3D model with TRELLIS.2 (textured, local), Hunyuan3D 2 (clean geometry in seconds, native MLX) or a remote LATO.2 service — with an interactive viewer, Fusion 360 handoff, and full Claude/ChatGPT control via MCP. Qwen3.8 27B joins the curated catalog with figures read from the file itself. Generated filenames now use 8-character suffixes so large batches cannot collide.
